topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, outlines the key learning objectives, and frames how cancer evolution and the microenvironment will be explored.

topics.label: Genetic Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Drivers of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through Darwinian clonal selection of genetic mutations alongside non-mutational epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Stem Cells, Tissue Hierarchy, and the Cell of Origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the role of stem cell hierarchy, stemness properties, and the cell of origin in initiating and propagating tumors.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Influences on Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate that tumor initiation and growth rely on permissive microenvironmental signals, inflammatory promoters, and supportive stromal interactions.

topics.label: Technological Methods and Evolutionary Synthesis of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the advanced profiling technologies used to study tumor biology and synthesize the multi-factorial evolutionary model of cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and provides an outlook on the upcoming topic.
